status: frozen before any evidence run (freeze commit recorded in the worklog); amendments only as labelled appended entries
batch_class: regular numbered batch WL93 (user brief; AGENTS.md numbering policy 2026-11-13)
question: Can ECRO achieve reproducible sharp interreflection fidelity with a physically shared local response operator once its source-stage response is explicitly supervised, or is source/receiver factor separation required beyond supervision and capacity effects?

hypotheses.H_IDENTIFIABILITY: stronger source-stage supervision improves the learned local response and sharp interreflection without factor untying
hypotheses.H_SHARING: even with identifiable source-stage supervision, tied factors prevent independently accurate source and receiver responses
hypotheses.H_INTERACTION: neither alone is sufficient, their combination yields a reproducible improvement

wl92b_reconciliation: before any WL93 evidence: prep93 recon92b re-evaluates WL92B H_interact / outcome under its written frozen rule; WL92B files are not modified; WL93 thresholds do not depend on it

architecture.base: ECRO v0 generator (model86, unchanged class), initialised from WL92A own_s<seed>
architecture.global_branch: frozen: the global term of WL92A own_s<seed> with its own factors (c, a, P, Q); identical for every arm of a seed (verified); never trained in WL93
architecture.single_flight: S = a_r . (c_r . flight(a_s . (c_s . s))) from a trainable copy of the OWN generator (trunk + local heads); its global heads are frozen and unused
architecture.disclosed_change: in every WL93 arm the single-flight local factors are decoupled from the global term's factors (needed to hold the global prediction identical across arms); 'tied' refers to source / receiver tying inside the single-flight term

modes.tied: c_s = c_r, a_s = a_r (heads head_c, head_a)
modes.untied: source (head_c, head_a), receiver (duplicated heads head_c2, head_a2), shared trunk
modes.tiedcm: capacity-matched tied control: one shared (c, a) = softplus(head(tb) + head2(tb)) with an additive second head of the same architecture (hidden layers freshly initialised from torch.Generator seed = run seed + 9300 with the nn.Linear default bound 1/sqrt(fan_in), output layer zero): a 2x-wide tied head with exactly the untied arm's trainable parameter count
modes.pre_freeze_correction: the first tiedcm design (copy-initialised duplicated heads, pre-activations averaged) was rejected before the freeze: it is symmetric, receives identical Adam updates and reproduced the tied arm bit-for-bit in the dev chain (degenerate control); the extra-parameter initialisation of tiedcm (fresh hidden / zero output) necessarily differs from untied (copies), disclosed

architecture.initialisation: every arm equals WL92A OWN exactly at step 0 (untied: duplicated heads are copies; tiedcm: the added head outputs zero; test T_INIT_EQUIV)

objective.OWN: mean(((S + G - t) / den)^2) + mean(((S - t2) / den)^2) + mean(((G - (t - t2)) / den)^2), den = t.mean(bins) + 0.05 t.mean(all) (the WL92A OWN objective; the last term is constant because G is frozen)
objective.source_stage: + w * mean(((Bq - q) / den_q)^2), Bq = a_s . (c_s . s) (the single-flight term's source-side once-scattered table), den_q = q.mean(bins) + 0.05 q.mean(all), w = 1 (fixed now)
objective.targets: t: stored WL86 target; t2: WL92A regenerated exactly-2-event target; q: offline physical once-scattered table quad87.qtable(P 16, Mq 1,024, seed 93000 + 4 idx + lighting) of the same geometry and light (no runtime use)

training.population: the WL92A population (WL86 train / val minus the WL92A E4 exclusion: 928 / 55 geometries x 4 lights)
training.note: fine-tuning phase from the converged OWN state; identical budget, data order and exposure for every arm of a seed; no extension, no seed replacement

source_stage.identifiability_gate: on the 55 validation geometries and E2 T0 / T1: the irreducible discrepancy of the exact frozen-ER operator through the deployed encoding (rel L1 of quad87.enc_matrix-applied s16 vs q on panel patches) must be <= 0.5 x the WL92A OWN learned discrepancy (Bq vs q on panel patches), both seeds; else STOP_TARGET_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE

e5.source: WL92B ~/rest_x92b (references, masks, truth split); inspected workload

e6.population: ordered candidates k from np.random.default_rng([93550, k]) with the WL92B E5 generation rule (sample_geom T0, one box moved >= 0.6 m, geom_ok)
e6.light: L1 (even k) / L2 (odd k): WL86 test lights excluded from every training light; held-out sources LMIX, LSPOT
e6.disjointness: every box centre of T0 / T1 >= 0.15 m from the same box of all 1,120 WL86 data files
e6.geometry_rule: A, C, D, E >= 1,000 px and C_footprint >= 1,000 px
e6.admission: WL86 stage-0 Q1-Q4, Q6, Q7 (Q4 SNR 4.0) AND light -> panel -> receiver 2-event share of the region-C higher-order reading at T1 >= 0.08 with SNR >= 4 (WL92B rule, prep93 e6admit)
e6.order: qualified BEFORE training; if no candidate is admitted: STOPPED_WORKLOAD_UNQUALIFIED, no training, no held-out claim

evaluation.models: 6 arms x 2 seeds; WL92A sum_s / own_s for context on E6
evaluation.controls: ORACLE table and explicit X_EXP on E6 T0 / T1

criteria.ADV(X, Y): for both seeds, on E6 (the admitted held-out) region C at T1 AND at T0: E_H(X) <= E_H(Y) - max(noise bound of X, noise bound of Y, 0.005)
criteria.STAGE(X, Y): for both seeds: panel-patch relative L1 of Bq vs q on E6 T1 and on E2 T1 of X <= 0.9 x that of Y
criteria.NOREG(X): for both seeds, against the same-seed T0 arm: no WL86 gate (F1; F2 in A and D; F4) passed by T0 is lost; stationary and D E_H <= 1.25 x T0 + 0.002 on E2 / E5 / E6 T0 and T1 and on every source configuration (E1 LSPOT, E5 LSPOT, E6 LMIX / LSPOT)
criteria.DYN(X): for both seeds: F3 (region D) not lost against T0 on E2, E5, E6
criteria.PASS_sup(X, Y): ADV and STAGE and NOREG(X) and DYN(X)

labels.INTERACTION_SUPPORTED: PASS_sup(UQ, T0) and PASS_share(UQ, CQ) and not PASS_sup(TQ, T0) and not PASS_share(U0, C0)
labels.SHARING_SUPPORTED: PASS_share(UQ, CQ) and PASS_share(UQ, TQ) (beyond matched supervision and capacity), unless INTERACTION_SUPPORTED; reported with the source / receiver operator difference on unchanged material (ownership caveat)
labels.IDENTIFIABILITY_SUPPORTED: PASS_sup(TQ, T0) and not PASS_share(UQ, CQ)
labels.NOT_SUPPORTED: none of PASS_sup(TQ, T0), PASS_sup(UQ, U0), PASS_share(U0, C0), PASS_share(UQ, CQ), PASS_sup(UQ, T0) holds
labels.STOPPED: a test / control / baseline reproduction fails, the target is not identifiable, or E6 is not admitted (STOPPED_WORKLOAD_UNQUALIFIED)
labels.note: labels do not authorise adoption; nested contrasts are not additive shares

diagnostics: per model: Bq vs q (all / panel; flux), source and receiver panel matrices vs frozen-ER M64 (flux norm: residual, mirror-bin retention), source - receiver matrix difference on unchanged material, receiver-stage response vs M64 on the model's own first-flight irradiance, region-C reading split (single level / directional, panel family delivered), panel matrix change E2 T0 -> T1, seed-to-seed variation; trainable parameters, head FLOPs, memory, train / inference time

tests.T_INIT_EQUIV: every arm at step 0 reproduces WL92A own_s<seed> tables on E2_T1 (<= 1e-5 relative)
tests.T_GLOBAL_IDENTITY: the global term of every trained arm equals the frozen own_s<seed> global term (identical)
tests.T_TIED: tied / tiedcm: c_s is c_r and a_s is a_r; untied: separate tensors and a gradient step on a source-only loss leaves the receiver heads unchanged; trainable parameter counts: untied = tiedcm > tied, OWN base and global heads frozen; after training the tiedcm and untied single-flight terms differ from tied (> 1e-4 relative; non-degenerate controls)
tests.T_LINEAR: zero input -> 0, superposition / scaling <= 1e-4, outputs >= 0 for every arm
tests.T_QTARGET: quad87.qtable with the WL87 seed reproduces the stored D q of E2 T1 exactly (target construction)
tests.T_NO_ORACLE: inference uses only (geometry state, source encoding): Local.factors(gs) and Local.single(f, gs, s) signatures
tests.T_REPRO: WL92A own_s<seed> E2 T1 / T0 tables via the WL93 table path, re-rendered (2 x 4,096 spp, seeds 86600 / 86601), vs WL92A's own renders: |region-C E_H difference| <= 1e-6 (set before the freeze from the full-scale probe: the re-rendered table differs from WL92A's at float32 ULP level, max |hl| difference 6e-8, single-half region-C E_H difference 4.2e-9; 1e-6 is three orders below the 0.005 decision margin)

scope: one room family, rigid box edits, three frozen ER materials, point / cone / two-light sources, 512^2, two seeds per arm; global branch frozen (LSPOT global regression not addressed). No global retraining, encoding change, capacity search, threshold change, new representation beyond the declared arms, adoption or successor.
